'''Gelpog the Tyrant''' was the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of several [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-occupied [[Asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant|hives]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], the designs of Gelpog were [[Engagement in the asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant|challenged]] by the efforts of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="LS1" />
